import NJY_Identity
import NJY_Checkpoint
import NJY_Master
import NJY_Entry
import NJY_Registry
import NJQ_Canonical
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NJY_Roots
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
/-- All five references target complete Results. Cut parameters below are the
reviewed source-ordered native transcriptions; no child-success, endpoint,
arbitrary operation dictionary or runtime Boolean is a separate premise. -/
theorem identity (b : Slice U8) :
 NJY_Identity.reference b=NJY_Identity.model b := NJY_Identity.source b

theorem checkpoint (b : Slice U8)
 (out : core.result.Result NJQ_Checkpoint.C NJQ_Checkpoint.F)
 (cut : NJY_Checkpoint.Cut b out) : ok out=NJY_Checkpoint.model b := by
 exact (NJY_Checkpoint.source b out cut).trans (NJQ_Checkpoint.source b)

theorem master (b : Slice U8)
 (out : core.result.Result NJQ_Master.M NJQ_Master.F)
 (cut : NJY_Master.Cut b out) : ok out=NJY_Master.model b := by
 exact (NJY_Master.source b out cut).trans (NJQ_Master.source b)

theorem entry (b : Slice U8) (log : Option NJI_V1Carrier.E)
 (out : core.result.Result NJI_V1Carrier.E NJI_V1Carrier.F)
 (cut : NJY_Entry.Cut b log out) : ok out=NJY_Entry.model b := by
 exact (NJY_Entry.source b log out cut).trans (NJQ_Entry.source b)

theorem registry (b : Slice U8) (log : Option NJI_V1Carrier.R)
 (out : core.result.Result NJI_V1Carrier.R NJI_V1Carrier.F)
 (cut : NJY_Registry.Cut b log out) : ok out=NJY_Registry.model b := by
 exact (NJY_Registry.source b log out cut).trans (NJQ_Registry.source b)

set_option pp.proofs false in
#print identity
#print axioms identity
set_option pp.proofs false in
#print checkpoint
#print axioms checkpoint
set_option pp.proofs false in
#print master
#print axioms master
set_option pp.proofs false in
#print entry
#print axioms entry
set_option pp.proofs false in
#print registry
#print axioms registry
end NJY_Roots

import NHY_PolicyReference
import NHJ_DeployedIds
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NHY_PolicyModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Policy := AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.format.VerifierPolicyV1
abbrev Error := AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.format.PoolV1FormatError

def code (flags : U8) (program_zero authority_zero binding_zero : Bool) : U8 :=
 if flags &&& (~~~ 3#u8) != 0#u8 then 1#u8
 else if program_zero || binding_zero then 2#u8
 else
  let immutable := flags &&& 1#u8 != 0#u8
  let deployment := flags &&& 2#u8 != 0#u8
  if deployment && !immutable then 3#u8
  else if immutable != authority_zero then 3#u8 else 0#u8

theorem extracted (flags : U8) (pz az bz : Bool) :
    NHY_PolicyReference.policy_ref flags pz az bz = ok (code flags pz az bz) := by
  simp only [NHY_PolicyReference.policy_ref,code,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  generalize (flags &&& (~~~ 3#u8) != 0#u8) = bad
  generalize (flags &&& 1#u8 != 0#u8) = immutable
  generalize (flags &&& 2#u8 != 0#u8) = deployment
  cases bad <;> cases immutable <;> cases deployment <;>
    cases pz <;> cases az <;> cases bz <;> rfl

def decode (c : U8) : core.result.Result Unit Error :=
 if c=0#u8 then .Ok () else
 if c=1#u8 then .Err .UnsupportedFlags else
 if c=2#u8 then .Err .ZeroRequiredBinding else .Err .InvalidAuthorityMode

def policy (p : Policy) : Result (core.result.Result Unit Error) := do
 let c ← NHY_PolicyReference.policy_ref p.flags
   (decide (p.registry_program = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
   (decide (p.registry_authority = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
   (decide (p.policy_binding = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
 ok (decode c)

theorem value (p : Policy) : policy p = ok (decode (code p.flags
    (decide (p.registry_program = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
    (decide (p.registry_authority = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
    (decide (p.policy_binding = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)))) := by
 unfold policy
 rw [extracted]
 rfl

/-- Bind this concrete helper in the real deployed pipeline; other fields are
unchanged. Native source/contract provenance is a separate P6 certificate. -/
def bindPolicy {E : Type} (missing : AspisR1.IDa_Deployed.Uninstalled E) :=
 {missing with adapter := {missing.adapter with op15 := policy}}

theorem actual_slot {E : Type} (missing : AspisR1.IDa_Deployed.Uninstalled E)
    (devnet : Bool) (indexError : E) (reservation : AspisR1.NP6_StdModel.Reservation) :
    (NHJ_DeployedIds.configuration (bindPolicy missing) devnet indexError reservation).adapter.op15 = policy := rfl

#print axioms extracted
#print axioms value
#print axioms actual_slot
end NHY_PolicyModel

import NJQ_Master
import NJQ_ChildTotal
import NJI_PolicyCut
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NJQ_MasterCut
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NJQ_Master
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def prefixResult (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) : core.result.Result Bool F :=
 match NJQ_Header.model b 384#usize magic with
 | .Err e=>.Err e
 | .Ok _=>if (reserved b len).val≠List.replicate 14 0#u8 then .Err .NonZeroReserved else
  if (tail b len).val≠List.replicate 8 0#u8 then .Err .NonZeroReserved else
  if bindingArg b len≠NJQ_MasterBinding.binding then .Err .WrongFormatBinding else
  parseBool (NHY_ZeroStep.byte b 49)

def Coordinates (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) (id : I) (policy : P)
 (has : Bool) (lanes : Words) (m : M) : Prop :=
 m.bump=NHY_ZeroStep.byte b 7 ∧ m.identity=id ∧ m.verifier_policy=policy ∧
 m.initialized_lane_mask=NHY_ZeroStep.byte b 48 ∧ m.has_checkpoint=has ∧
 m.next_checkpoint_sequence=NJQ_Words.word b 40 (by omega) ∧
 ∀ i,i<8 → NHY_ArrayExt.coord m.last_checkpoint_lane_sequences i=NHY_ArrayExt.coord lanes i

theorem complete_record (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) (id : I) (policy : P)
 (has : Bool) (lanes : Words) (m : M) (h : Coordinates b len id policy has lanes m) :
 m=record b len id policy has lanes := by
 have seq : m.last_checkpoint_lane_sequences=lanes := by
  apply NHY_ArrayExt.whole
  intro i hi _
  exact h.2.2.2.2.2.2 i hi
 obtain ⟨hb,hi,hp,hm,hh,hn,_⟩:=h
 cases m
 unfold record
 simp_all

/-- Ordered prefix, closed child calls at their exact windows, one arbitrary
native step iterated by induction, full constructor and validator Result.
No accepted-child or endpoint premise is admitted. The argument/frame cuts
are the retained K025/K027 source stages; this support is not row credit. -/
def Cut (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) (out : core.result.Result M F) : Prop :=
 match prefixResult b len with
 | .Err e=>out=.Err e
 | .Ok has=>
  match NJQ_ChildTotal.identity (identityArg b) with
  | .Err _=>out=.Err .Identity
  | .Ok id=>
   match NJQ_ChildTotal.policy (policyArg b) with
   | .Err _=>out=.Err .Policy
   | .Ok policy=>∃ lanes,
    NJQ_MasterTrace.Writes (sequences b len) 0 (Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u64) lanes ∧
    ∃ m,Coordinates b len id policy has lanes m ∧
     match NJQ_ChildTotal.master m with
     | .Err e=>out=.Err e
     | .Ok _=>out=.Ok m

def pipeline (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) : core.result.Result M F :=
 match prefixResult b len with
 | .Err e=>.Err e
 | .Ok has=>
  match NJQ_ChildTotal.identity (identityArg b) with
  | .Err _=>.Err .Identity
  | .Ok id=>
   match NJQ_ChildTotal.policy (policyArg b) with
   | .Err _=>.Err .Policy
   | .Ok policy=>
    let m:=record b len id policy has (sequences b len)
    match NJQ_ChildTotal.master m with | .Err e=>.Err e | .Ok _=>.Ok m

theorem cut_result (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) (out : core.result.Result M F)
 (cut : Cut b len out) : out=pipeline b len := by
 unfold Cut at cut
 unfold pipeline
 cases hp : prefixResult b len with
 | Err e=>simp only [hp] at cut ⊢;exact cut
 | Ok has=>
  simp only [hp] at cut ⊢
  cases hi : NJQ_ChildTotal.identity (identityArg b) with
  | Err e=>simp only [hi] at cut ⊢;exact cut
  | Ok id=>
   simp only [hi] at cut ⊢
   cases hpol : NJQ_ChildTotal.policy (policyArg b) with
   | Err e=>simp only [hpol] at cut ⊢;exact cut
   | Ok policy=>
    simp only [hpol] at cut ⊢
    obtain ⟨lanes,trace,m,coords,post⟩:=cut
    have same:=NJQ_MasterTrace.initial (sequences b len) lanes trace
    subst lanes
    rw [complete_record b len id policy has (sequences b len) m coords] at post
    cases hv : NJQ_ChildTotal.master (record b len id policy has (sequences b len)) <;>
     simp only [hv] at post ⊢ <;> exact post

theorem model_closed (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) : model b=ok (pipeline b len) := by
 unfold model pipeline prefixResult
 simp only [dif_pos len,NJQ_ChildTotal.identity_value,NJQ_ChildTotal.policy_value,
  NJQ_ChildTotal.master_value,bind_tc_ok]
 cases hh : NJQ_Header.model b 384#usize magic with
 | Err e=>simp only [hh]
 | Ok u=>
  simp only [hh]
  by_cases hr : (reserved b len).val=List.replicate 14 0#u8 <;>
   by_cases ht : (tail b len).val=List.replicate 8 0#u8 <;>
   by_cases hb : bindingArg b len=NJQ_MasterBinding.binding <;> simp_all
  all_goals cases parseBool (NHY_ZeroStep.byte b 49) <;> simp_all
  all_goals cases NJQ_ChildTotal.identity (identityArg b) <;> simp_all
  all_goals cases NJQ_ChildTotal.policy (policyArg b) <;> simp_all
  all_goals cases NJQ_ChildTotal.master _ <;> rfl

theorem native_source (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=384) (out : core.result.Result M F)
 (cut : Cut b len out) : ok out=reference b := by
 rw [source,model_closed b len]
 exact congrArg Result.ok (cut_result b len out cut)

set_option pp.proofs false in
#print native_source
#print axioms complete_record
#print axioms cut_result
#print axioms model_closed
#print axioms native_source
end NJQ_MasterCut

import NJQ_Checkpoint
import NJI_PolicyCut
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NJQ_CheckpointCut
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NJQ_Checkpoint
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def prefixResult (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) : core.result.Result Unit F :=
 match NJQ_Header.model b 192#usize magic with
 | .Err e=>.Err e
 | .Ok _=>if (trailing b len).val≠List.replicate 16 0#u8 then .Err .NonZeroReserved else
   if masterBytes b len=Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 then .Err .ZeroRequiredBinding else
   if domainBytes b len=Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 then .Err .ZeroRequiredBinding else .Ok ()

def Coordinates (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) (root : Digest) (lanes : Words) (p : C) : Prop :=
 p.bump=NHY_ZeroStep.byte b 7 ∧ p.checkpoint_sequence=NJQ_Words.word b 72 (by omega) ∧
 (∀ i,i<32 → NHY_ArrayExt.coord p.master i=NHY_ZeroStep.byte b (8+i) ∧
   NHY_ArrayExt.coord p.deployment_domain i=NHY_ZeroStep.byte b (40+i)) ∧
 (∀ i,i<8 → NHY_ArrayExt.coord p.global_root i=NHY_ArrayExt.coord root i ∧
   NHY_ArrayExt.coord p.lane_sequences i=NHY_ArrayExt.coord lanes i)

theorem complete_record (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) (root : Digest) (lanes : Words) (p : C)
 (h : Coordinates b len root lanes p) : p=record b len root lanes := by
 have hm : p.master=masterBytes b len := by
  apply NHY_ArrayExt.whole
  intro i hi _
  rw [show masterBytes b len=NHY_NaturalReads.array b 8 32#usize (by change 8+32≤b.val.length;omega) from rfl]
  rw [NJI_PolicyCut.field_coordinate b 8 i _ hi]
  exact (h.2.2.1 i hi).1
 have hd : p.deployment_domain=domainBytes b len := by
  apply NHY_ArrayExt.whole
  intro i hi _
  rw [show domainBytes b len=NHY_NaturalReads.array b 40 32#usize (by change 40+32≤b.val.length;omega) from rfl]
  rw [NJI_PolicyCut.field_coordinate b 40 i _ hi]
  exact (h.2.2.1 i hi).2
 have hr : p.global_root=root := by
  apply NHY_ArrayExt.whole
  intro i hi _
  exact (h.2.2.2 i hi).1
 have hl : p.lane_sequences=lanes := by
  apply NHY_ArrayExt.whole
  intro i hi _
  exact (h.2.2.2 i hi).2
 have hb:=h.1
 have hs:=h.2.1
 cases p
 unfold record at *
 simp_all

/-- Source-ordered composition of native prefix, digest-result, one-step loop,
and constructor clauses. Std any and digest146 replies are instantiated internally.
The Trace rejecting constructor has no suffix; input is shared immutable throughout. -/
def Cut (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) (out : core.result.Result C F) : Prop :=
 match prefixResult b len with
 | .Err e=>out=.Err e
 | .Ok _=>∃ arg : Array U8 32#usize,
   (∀ i,i<32 → NHY_ArrayExt.coord arg i=NHY_ZeroStep.byte b (80+i)) ∧
   match NJQ_DigestPort.decoded arg with
   | .Err _=>out=.Err .NonCanonicalDigest
   | .Ok root=>∃ loopOut,
     NJQ_CheckpointTrace.Trace (sequences b len) 0 (Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u64) loopOut ∧
     match loopOut with
     | .Err e=>out=.Err e
     | .Ok lanes=>∃ p,out=.Ok p ∧ Coordinates b len root lanes p

def pipeline (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) : core.result.Result C F :=
 match prefixResult b len with
 | .Err e=>.Err e
 | .Ok _=>match NJQ_DigestPort.decoded (digestArg b len) with
   | .Err _=>.Err .NonCanonicalDigest
   | .Ok root=>match NJQ_ArrayAll.loop (sequences b len) with
     | .Err e=>.Err e
     | .Ok lanes=>.Ok (record b len root lanes)

theorem cut_result (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) (out : core.result.Result C F)
 (cut : Cut b len out) : out=pipeline b len := by
 unfold Cut at cut
 unfold pipeline
 cases hp : prefixResult b len with
 | Err e=>simp only [hp] at cut ⊢;exact cut
 | Ok u=>
   simp only [hp] at cut ⊢
   obtain ⟨arg,coords,post⟩:=cut
   have same : arg=digestArg b len := by
    apply NHY_ArrayExt.whole
    intro i hi _
    rw [show digestArg b len=NHY_NaturalReads.array b 80 32#usize (by change 80+32≤b.val.length;omega) from rfl]
    rw [NJI_PolicyCut.field_coordinate b 80 i _ hi]
    exact coords i hi
   subst arg
   cases hg : NJQ_DigestPort.decoded (digestArg b len) with
   | Err e=>simp only [hg] at post ⊢;exact post
   | Ok root=>
     simp only [hg] at post ⊢
     obtain ⟨loopOut,trace,post⟩:=post
     have same:=NJQ_ArrayAll.native_result (sequences b len) loopOut trace
     rw [same] at post
     cases hl : NJQ_ArrayAll.loop (sequences b len) with
     | Err e=>simp only [hl] at post ⊢;exact post
     | Ok lanes=>
       simp only [hl] at post ⊢
       obtain ⟨p,ret,coords⟩:=post
       rw [complete_record b len root lanes p coords] at ret
       exact ret

theorem model_closed (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) : model b=ok (pipeline b len) := by
 unfold model pipeline prefixResult
 simp only [dif_pos len]
 cases hh : NJQ_Header.model b 192#usize magic with
 | Err e=>simp only [hh]
 | Ok u=>
   simp only [hh]
   by_cases hz : (trailing b len).val=List.replicate 16 0#u8 <;>
    by_cases hm : masterBytes b len=Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 <;>
    by_cases hd : domainBytes b len=Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 <;> simp_all
   all_goals cases NJQ_DigestPort.decoded (digestArg b len) <;> simp_all
   all_goals cases NJQ_ArrayAll.loop (sequences b len) <;> rfl

/-- (aq)(2): input and the reviewed parent cut only. Child/digest and loop laws
are discharged above on the same byte argument; no accepted-output premise. -/
theorem native_source (b : Slice U8) (len : b.val.length=192) (out : core.result.Result C F)
 (cut : Cut b len out) : ok out=reference b := by
 rw [source,model_closed b len]
 exact congrArg Result.ok (cut_result b len out cut)

set_option pp.proofs false in
#print native_source
#print axioms complete_record
#print axioms cut_result
#print axioms model_closed
#print axioms native_source
end NJQ_CheckpointCut

import NKF_BoxModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NKF_MasterBox
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev M := NJQ_Carrier.CM
abbrev F := NJQ_Carrier.CF
/-- SAME arguments, complete raw law, wrapper error map, safe Box value model.
The pure carrier is the canonical slot48 carrier; no free operation dictionary. -/
def reference (b : Slice U8) := NKF_BoxModel.outer (NJQ_Canonical.master b)

theorem raw_child (b : Slice U8)
 (raw : core.result.Result NJQ_Carrier.M NJQ_Carrier.F)
 (cut : NJQ_MasterTotal.Cut b raw) :
 ok (NKF_BoxModel.tail (NJQ_Carrier.master_result raw)) = reference b := by
 exact NKF_BoxModel.congruence _ _ (NJQ_Canonical.master_result b raw cut)

/-- Typed native tail predicate. This equation is licensed only by the
universal wrapper tail cut/controls, not by a successful child or endpoint. -/
def TailCut (raw : core.result.Result M F)
 (out : core.result.Result M NKF_BoxModel.PE) : Prop :=
 out = NKF_BoxModel.tail raw

theorem source (b : Slice U8)
 (raw : core.result.Result NJQ_Carrier.M NJQ_Carrier.F)
 (rawCut : NJQ_MasterTotal.Cut b raw)
 (out : core.result.Result M NKF_BoxModel.PE)
 (native : TailCut (NJQ_Carrier.master_result raw) out) :
 ok out = reference b := by
 rw [native]
 exact raw_child b raw rawCut

set_option pp.proofs false in
#print raw_child
#print axioms raw_child
set_option pp.proofs false in
#print source
#print axioms source
end NKF_MasterBox

import NMN_OracleFold
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NMN_064
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result VTop_Stages AspisR1 NLW_Full064
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
/-- Exact native allocation class, all predicates on064's own input slices.
The caller must supply getter/encoder facts; no child success is assumed. -/
structure Domain {X : Type} (a : Args X) : Prop where
 proofExtent : a.proof.val.length=57607
 checkpointExtent : a.checkpoint.val.length=1768
 publicBound : a.publicBytes.val.length≤1880
 root0 : NLP_InputDomain.Root0 a.checkpoint a.proof
/-- The actual CLOSED emitted parser at this recorded input. Its adopted
parser equality is derived below, not stored as a successful-child premise. -/
def ParserNative (proof : Slice U8) (reply : NMN_OracleFold.ParserReply) : Prop :=
 reply = NJS_Parse.map NLE_ParseInstall.reply (NJS_Parse.map NJS_Parse.reply
  (NJS_Extract.verifier.candidate.parse_shape
   Op3I_Std.ops.sliceNe Op3I_Std.ops.sliceEq Op3I_Std.ops.iterAny proof))
/-- Reviewed native G relation certified by NMN cuts under(bl). ChildNative
is an entered execution at precisely the recorded arguments, not its law.
The parent has no writes/events between calls; stopped End has prefix only. -/
inductive Native {Ambient X : Type} (H : Bytes → State) (s : Frame Ambient X) :
 End H s.args → List (Event Ambient X) → Prop where
 | observed (parsed : NMN_OracleFold.ParserReply)
   (common : transport.Variant → NLT_CompleteRoot.End H s.args.digest s.args.hash)
   (parser : ParserNative s.args.proof parsed)
   (child : ∀ v, parsed=.ok (.Ok v) → NLT_CompleteRoot.Native H s.args.digest
     s.args.publicBytes s.args.proof s.args.checkpoint s.args.hash (common v)) :
   Native H s (NMN_OracleFold.run H s parsed common).1 (NMN_OracleFold.run H s parsed common).2

def RowSpec {Ambient X : Type} (H : Bytes → State) (s : Frame Ambient X) : Prop :=
 (∀ outcome events,Native H s outcome events →
  Law H s.args outcome ∧ events=chronology H s outcome) ∧
 (∀ v,NLE_ParseInstall.parse s.args.proof=.ok (.Ok v) →
  ∀ records,¬NLT_NativeInvocation.Invalid H s.args.digest s.args.hash
   (NLT_NativeSource.skeleton H s.args.digest s.args.publicBytes s.args.proof
    s.args.checkpoint s.args.hash) records)

theorem parser {proof : Slice U8} {reply : NMN_OracleFold.ParserReply}
 (native : ParserNative proof reply) : reply=NLE_ParseInstall.parse proof :=
 native.trans (NLE_ParseInstall.emitted proof).symm
/-- Candidate semantic root. Native certificate/gate status is recorded in
NMN_CLOSED.json; this theorem alone does not confer ledger credit. -/
theorem root {Ambient X : Type} (H : Bytes → State) (s : Frame Ambient X)
 (domain : Domain s.args) : RowSpec H s := by
 have own : NMK_Domain.Caller s.args := ⟨domain.publicBound,domain.root0⟩
 constructor
 · intro outcome events native
   cases native with
   | observed parsed common parsedNative child =>
    exact NMN_OracleFold.composed H s own parsed common (parser parsedNative) child
 · intro v parsed records
   exact (NMK_Domain.child H s.args own v parsed).2 records

#print root

#print axioms root
end NMN_064

import NMS_R2N_Interpreted
import NMS_ScanLength
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NMS_R2N_ScanSites
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_terminal
variable {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLift Result M]
local instance : MonadLift Result Result where
 monadLift := id
/-- Frozen scan_proof_buffer: Box::new is AFTER decoding and BEFORE encoding,
comparison and tag. The successful candidate payload survives unchanged. -/
def scan (allocate : M Unit) (bytes : Slice U8) : M (core.result.Result
 AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.ScannedAsqaProof AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError) := do
 let expected ← lift (Usize.checked_add 688#usize 57607#usize)
 match expected with
 | none => ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
 | some size =>
   if Slice.len bytes != size then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else do
    let header ← core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
     bytes {start:=0#usize,«end»:=688#usize}
    let decoded ← decode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 header
    match decoded with
    | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
    | .Ok candidate =>
      let _ ← allocate
      let encoded ← encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 candidate
      match encoded with
      | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
      | .Ok encoded =>
        if encoded.val != header.val then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else do
         let tag ← Slice.index_usize bytes 696#usize
         if tag != 2#u8 then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else
          ok (.Ok ⟨AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.fromPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 candidate,57607#usize⟩)

def interpreted (bytes : Slice U8) := scan (M := RSL.Spec) RSL.Spec.alloc bytes

/-- Exact value projection to the CLOSED scanner source. The allocation
operation is interpreted separately by the retained std/allocator item. -/
theorem erases (bytes : Slice U8) :
 scan (M := Result) (ok ()) bytes = AspisR1.NFY_JHf_Scan.source bytes := by
 unfold scan AspisR1.NFY_JHf_Scan.source
 simp only [bind_tc_ok]
 rfl
#print axioms erases

set_option autoImplicit false

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std AdapterRw
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Auth := r1_pool_adapter.AuthenticatedAsq8Accounts
abbrev Candidate := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1

def asset (r : Request) : U32 :=
 match r.«public» with | .PrivateTransfer p => p.asset_id | .Withdrawal p => p.asset_id

def reaches_boxes (r : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) : Prop :=
 a.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val + 1 = c.next_pair_index.val ∧ a.master.identity.asset_id = asset r

/-- Source sites r1_pool_adapter.rs:874/asq8_common:814 and statement_box:832
or849: both allocations precede statement validation. They have no observable
intermediate event, but each stop carries only the prefix. -/
def meaning (r : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) : RSL.Spec
 (core.result.Result aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
  solana_program_error.ProgramError) :=
 if reaches_boxes r a c then
  RSL.Spec.bind RSL.Spec.alloc (fun _ => RSL.Spec.bind RSL.Spec.alloc
   (fun _ => NMS_R2N_Interpreted.liftResult (AspisR1.NFY_JHf_ReconstructionSlot.source r a c)))
 else NMS_R2N_Interpreted.liftResult (AspisR1.NFY_JHf_ReconstructionSlot.source r a c)

/-- Every normal result is the exact CLOSED reconstruction source result;
private allocation aborts do not acquire an invented returned statement. -/
theorem regular (r : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) :
 NMS_R2N_Regular.Law (meaning r a c) (AspisR1.NFY_JHf_ReconstructionSlot.source r a c) := by
 unfold meaning
 split
 · apply NMS_R2N_AllocationRegular.bind
   apply NMS_R2N_AllocationRegular.bind
   exact NMS_R2N_Regular.lift _
 · exact NMS_R2N_Regular.lift _
#print axioms regular
end NMS_R2N_ReconstructSites
